title: festuca violacea subsp. atrata
intro: Festuca violacea subsp. atrata, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, such as stress, anxiety, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
